text:
len: Quick internal update — were GAing the new HorizonRT family (rt-nano, rt-pro, rt-max) for hosted API and flipping on Smart Routing by default for new workspaces. Small customer-facing note will go out after canary checks. :tada:

ashley: Nice! Whats the difference between rt-pro and rt-max?

len: rt-pro is tuned for balanced latency/cost for streaming; rt-max gives the lowest tail latency for synchronous realtime at higher resource density. Both support tool-calling primitives.

devex: Migration / sample snippets live here: https://redwood.ai/docs/hosted/horizonrt. New endpoints are additive: POST /v1/realtime/stream (streaming) and /v1/generate-rt (non-streaming).

ashley: Default Smart Routing on means fallbacks may route across regions? Any opt-outs?

len: It can route to compatible variants in other regions or quantized flavors when health signals degrade. Per-route opt-out in Console or set header x-rw-routing-policy: "no-fallback". Were keeping legacy realtime endpoints intact.

deploy-bot: rollout 1872.11 started by len  canary 5% us-west-2. Dashboard: https://deploy.redwood.ai/1872.11

ops: Oncall will monitor canary for 72h. Thresholds: p95 +20% or error-rate >2x baseline trigger investigation.

cs: Heads-up for support teams  please hold off on outward comms until product posts the official release note. We'll have a canned reply for customers testing streaming.

len: Thanks all. If you do smoke tests, file issues on the rollout board and tag ops. Appreciate swift checks. :rocket:
